items.name: Proxy rebuild
items.summary: Moving four standalone Paper servers onto one Velocity proxy, with shared permissions, unified chat, and player data that follows people between servers. Next up is party sync and a load test at 400 concurrent.

items.name: Season three systems
items.summary: A custom progression season with tiered quests, seasonal cosmetics, and a leaderboard that ties Discord roles to in game rank. Tier four and five rewards still need balancing.

items.name: Staff training programme
items.summary: A hiring and training setup I can reuse across clients. Application scoring, a two week onboarding path, and an escalation ladder that survives contact with real drama.
